veranderings.blok: Vir die mens self en vir die gemeenskap
veranderings.rede: 'sy eie plek' is the natural Afrikaans phrase; ''n eie plek' sounds wooden.

veranderings.voor: die oproep tot gebed saggies in
veranderings.rede: 'fluister' already means speaking softly, so 'saggies' is redundant.

veranderings.voor: Bure en vriende kom om die baba te sien.
veranderings.na: Bure en vriende kom die baba sien.
veranderings.rede: 'kom die baba sien' is the natural Afrikaans construction; 'kom om ... te sien' reads like a translation.
The fixed expression is 'onder water' without the article.
The rest of the lesson uses the possessive 'hulle'; keep it consistent.
'gee' needs a recipient here; without one the second half of the coordination hangs loose.

veranderings.voor: wat saam aan dieselfde kerk behoort
veranderings.rede: 'saam' is repeated in 'saamkom' at the end of the same short sentence and adds nothing beside 'dieselfde'.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: voorouers - "Die mense in jou familie van wie jy afstam en wat reeds oorlede is, soos 'n ouma of oupa wat al gesterf het."
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The definition says the same thing twice ('reeds oorlede is' and 'wat al gesterf het'); also the recorded reason mentions 'voor jou gebore is', which does not appear in the decided wording, so a person may want to confirm this is the intended final form.
